messages:
maya: Heads-up — AtlasHealth just flagged a launch blocker: they need per-route error->cost correlation + trace links in the console before they sign Dedicated. They said it's the only thing blocking their security review.

kevin: ack. do we have a scoped proposal for this? is this dashboards + trace-hook + cost attribution or something heavier? :thinking_face:

sasha: summary from sales: customer wants to answer 'which endpoints cause 90% of error budget burn and what tokens/calls are driving cost' — needs per-route breakdown, sample traces for high-error spikes, and a gated rollout.

neil: high level tradeoffs: naive approach = full trace capture for errored requests (very costly), better = adaptive sampling + prefix/KV tagging to attach cost metadata. we can prototype with sampling at 5% for errors and 0.1% baseline.

maya: concrete ask for product: 1) dashboard widget showing per-route error rate + cost-per-10k-requests 2) trace link from error row to sample traces 3) launch acceptance: evidence pack with sample traces + cost delta estimate < 8% of normal telemetry spend.

kevin: sounds reasonable. ops question: what storage/retention assumptions? customer expects 30d retention for traces tied to these spikes.

sasha: propose retaining sampled trace bodies for 7d by default; keep spans/indices 30d. enterprise customers (Dedicated/Private) can request 30d full retention as an add-on.

neil: instrumentation notes for eng-runtime: we need a low-overhead hook that 1) tags request with route_id 2) records token count + model id 3) emits error flag for sampling decision. sketch config:

```
telemetry:
  trace_sampling:
    baseline_rate: 0.001
    error_rate: 0.05
  attributes:
    - route_id
    - model_id
    - token_count
```

maya: can product create launch criteria checklist? I think we need: feature implemented, sampling config validated on canary, customer-specific retention option documented, and cost-econ estimate for a 1M QPS-equivalent workload.

kevin: action items: @sasha to draft UX wire for dashboard (ETA 3d), @neil to prototype runtime hook + sampling (ETA 5d), @maya to prepare acceptance template and coordinate AtlasHealth POC (ETA 2d).

sasha: will include a compact widget that shows: per-route cost (USD/10k), error rate, traces link. low-fidelity mock in 48h. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

neil: note — we should surface quantization/quant-perf caveat: token counting has +/- variance with gzip vs raw. add a footnote in dashboard.

product-bot: rollup: tasks created in board: PROD-7834 (dashboard mock), PROD-7835 (trace hook prototype), PROD-7836 (acceptance pack). @maya assigned.

maya: thanks — I'll loop in solutions engineer for AtlasHealth so we can run a quick canary. please mark any infra hard limits needed for Dedicated customers.

kevin: one more thing — add canary gating: fail if projected telemetry spend > 12% of existing monitoring budget for same window. otherwise green.

maya: agreed. keeping this tight. i'll sync with sales tomorrow and post a short update here. :thumbsup:
